parts.text: I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. A company may run a few hundred drones of several models from different manufacturers, and they differ in how much they can carry, how far they can fly on a full battery, which sensors they carry, and which charging connector they use. Choosing the drone and the way it flies is my legal responsibility, and our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
